label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value is attacker-controlled user input (param) written directly into HTML data-name attribute despite incomplete sanitization. The replace("\"", """) only escapes double quotes, leaving single quotes and other dangerous characters unescaped. Attacker can bypass via single-quote injection (e.g., \' to break attribute boundary), enabling script execution.

evidence.note: User input param flows to bar variable with insufficient sanitization before direct HTML output
